proposals.title: Rifle sight-edge emissive rim
proposals.change: Add a thin warm emissive rim along the rifle irons proxy sight housing.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a low-intensity masked overlay mesh or material layer; preserve the existing ADS HF checker/stripe material underneath.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Small additive emissive accent stays within the frozen ADS composition and does not introduce a dark sole FOV material.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; HF checkers/stripes remain visible; sight housing gains a readable edge highlight without clipping.

proposals.title: Barrel-bore highlight cue
proposals.change: Add a narrow emissive crescent at the visible barrel-bore opening.
proposals.implementation_notes: Keep the crescent small and offset from the bore center so the opening remains legible rather than becoming a filled bright disc.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A tiny emissive proxy improves barrel recognition without changing the HF base or adding a dark material.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; bore opening reads at capture resolution; no full-disc washout or checker loss occurs.

proposals.title: Glove trigger-contact marker
proposals.change: Add a small emissive contact notch where the glove meets the trigger guard.
proposals.implementation_notes: Place the accent only at the contact seam, using a subdued amber value and no broad glove recolor.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The accent is localized to an existing glove-rifle junction and leaves all frozen HF surfaces unchanged.
proposals.acceptance_test: Both ADS and Cockpit remain Usable; contact seam is visible; no emissive spill reaches the sight picture.

proposals.title: Igla nose stripe
proposals.change: Add one thin emissive identification stripe to the Igla proxy nose section.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a short stripe aligned to the nose contour; do not cover the underlying HF checker/stripe field.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A single thin additive stripe increases Igla silhouette identification with negligible screen coverage.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; Igla nose reads as a distinct object; HF stripes remain intact around it.

proposals.title: Igla fin-tip glints
proposals.change: Add two tiny emissive glints to the visible Igla fin tips.
proposals.implementation_notes: Limit the effect to two sub-pixel-to-pixel tip accents with low exposure response.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Tiny tip accents improve fin readability without adding a large hero element or altering base materials.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; both visible fin tips separate from the background; no bright bloom obscures the sight picture.

proposals.title: Iron-sight post cap
proposals.change: Add a small emissive cap to the top of the front iron-sight post.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a thin rectangular cap matching the post width; preserve the open sight gap and HF pattern behind it.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The change is a small additive cue on an existing sight landmark and does not fill the reticle gap.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; front post and sight gap remain clearly separated; checker/stripe density is unchanged.

proposals.title: Rear-aperture locator dot
proposals.change: Add one dim emissive locator dot beside the rear aperture of the irons proxy.
proposals.implementation_notes: Place the dot outside the aperture opening so it supports orientation without becoming a second aiming point.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: One low-intensity pixel-scale cue improves rear-sight localization without touching the frozen HF base.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; aperture remains open; locator dot is visible but does not compete with the front post.

proposals.title: Glove knuckle-plane accent
proposals.change: Add a narrow emissive accent across the glove knuckle plane nearest the rifle grip.
proposals.implementation_notes: Mask a single short segment on the existing glove geometry; retain the glove's HF pattern and avoid a full-hand material override.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A tiny anatomical edge cue gives the glove readable form while maintaining all frozen unlit HF detail.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; knuckle plane separates from the rifle grip; no broad glove brightening occurs.

proposals.title: Magazine-lip contour accent
proposals.change: Add a thin emissive line along the visible magazine-lip contour of the rifle proxy.
proposals.implementation_notes: Restrict the line to the upper lip contour and keep intensity below the iron-sight accents.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The localized additive line improves weapon-part segmentation without replacing or obscuring HF stripes.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; magazine lip is distinguishable; line does not read as a large glowing weapon body.

proposals.title: Charging-handle notch
proposals.change: Add a small emissive notch at the visible charging-handle position.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a short masked notch with hard edges and no animation or particle trail.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A small hard-edged additive mark improves recognition of a functional rifle cue with minimal coverage.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; charging-handle notch is readable; no bloom crosses the sight alignment.

proposals.title: Igla seeker collar ring
proposals.change: Add a thin emissive ring around the Igla seeker collar.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a partial ring if necessary to avoid a solid luminous band; keep the center and HF surface visible.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A narrow collar ring strengthens Igla identity while remaining a low-area additive accent.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; seeker collar separates from adjacent geometry; no solid dark or bright material replaces the base.

proposals.title: Glove-thumb grip contact seam
proposals.change: Add a short emissive seam at the glove thumb-to-grip contact point.
proposals.implementation_notes: Keep the seam under the thumb silhouette and use a low-intensity warm-neutral color.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The seam is confined to an existing contact boundary and cannot replace the HF densify field.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS and Cockpit remain Usable; thumb contact reads clearly; no visible material change spreads across the glove.

proposals.title: Front-sight side tick
proposals.change: Add one small emissive side tick to the front iron-sight blade.
proposals.implementation_notes: Place the tick on one side of the blade, leaving the central aiming post unchanged.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A single small side cue improves blade orientation without introducing a competing center marker.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; central sight alignment is unchanged; tick is visible only as a minor orientation cue.

proposals.title: Barrel seam dash
proposals.change: Add a short emissive dash at the visible barrel-to-receiver seam.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use one broken dash rather than a continuous ring to preserve the sparse, thin-accent look.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The broken dash adds a unique weapon landmark while retaining the frozen HF checker/stripe material.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; barrel and receiver read as separate forms; dash stays below glare and bloom thresholds.

proposals.title: Igla fin-root seam
proposals.change: Add one short emissive seam at the root of the visible Igla guidance fin.
proposals.implementation_notes: Follow the fin root for a few pixels only; do not outline the entire fin or body.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A tiny fin-root seam clarifies Igla construction with negligible screen-space impact.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; fin root is distinguishable; existing HF stripes remain visible on the adjacent Igla surface.

proposals.title: Glove index-finger edge cue
proposals.change: Add a thin emissive edge cue along the index finger silhouette near the trigger.
proposals.implementation_notes: Limit the cue to the outward silhouette edge and leave the finger interior untouched.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The edge-only accent improves glove-versus-rifle separation without a full glove recolor.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; index finger silhouette is readable; no cue overlaps the front sight post.

proposals.title: Sight-block micro bevel
proposals.change: Add a tiny unlit high-frequency bevel strip to the side of the rear sight block.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a narrow checker-compatible HF strip only; do not use a solid dark PBR or dark metal material and do not alter the main ADS HF field.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The strip is unlit HF-only and preserves the capture freeze's checker/stripe treatment.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; rear sight block gains a readable side edge; HF pattern density does not decrease.

proposals.title: Igla body break accent
proposals.change: Add one short additive emissive break mark on the Igla body behind the seeker collar.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a single diagonal mark sized below the collar ring; keep it away from the sight centerline.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The mark is small, additive, and spatially separated from the primary aiming cue.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; Igla body orientation is clearer; no HF checker/stripe region is replaced.

proposals.title: Grip-index alignment dash
proposals.change: Add a small emissive alignment dash where the glove index line meets the rifle grip contour.
proposals.implementation_notes: Treat the dash as one contact accent spanning the seam; keep it shorter than the glove contact marker.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The accent is confined to one glove-rifle seam and adds no broad hero geometry.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; glove-to-grip alignment reads immediately; no visible loss of ADS HF detail occurs.

proposals.title: Muzzle-side identification tick
proposals.change: Add one tiny emissive identification tick on the visible muzzle sidewall.
proposals.implementation_notes: Place the tick perpendicular to the muzzle edge, with low intensity and no bloom-heavy treatment.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A pixel-scale additive tick provides a unique muzzle cue while leaving the HF densify intact.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; muzzle sidewall is distinguishable; tick does not become a dominant bright artifact or obscure the sight picture.
